design.name: easy-run-donation
design.designPurpose: Baseline endpoint donation; second run offers duplicate origins.
design.parameterInvestigation: Source length 6; retained core 5; investigate source lengths 4–8, proving each inventory.

design.name: easy-both-ends
design.designPurpose: Both ends feed different groups, retaining blue 3–5.
design.parameterInvestigation: One tile per end; four rack tiles; review whether it feels like two chores.

design.name: easy-group-donation
design.designPurpose: Four-colour group donates blue 6 to a run.
design.parameterInvestigation: Donor at end of run; retained group exactly 3.

design.name: easy-group-middle-donation
design.designPurpose: The donated tile fills the middle of a new run.
design.parameterInvestigation: Donor position varies from endpoint to middle, with two rack neighbours.

design.name: easy-run-division
design.designPurpose: Two overlapping valid runs use the second physical copies.
design.parameterInvestigation: Source length 6; one cut, prefix/suffix >=2; duplicate overlap width 2.

design.name: easy-longer-division
design.designPurpose: Same overlap with a longer suffix and different possible allocations.
design.parameterInvestigation: Source length 7 instead of 6; do not assume further lengths preserve proof.

design.name: medium-interior-extraction
design.designPurpose: Two runs split around a shared 4 group.
design.parameterInvestigation: Both source runs length 7; support row required by minimum row count.

design.name: medium-asymmetric-interior
design.designPurpose: Unequal surviving fragments introduce asymmetric lengths.
design.parameterInvestigation: Blue length 8, red length 7; same forced extraction position.

design.name: medium-split-and-join
design.designPurpose: A short second-source remainder must join the divided first run.
design.parameterInvestigation: Extract 4 and 10; second remainder length 2; no independent rack repair.

design.name: medium-longer-split-join
design.designPurpose: Longer repaired run can be divided in more than one complete solution.
design.parameterInvestigation: First run length 8, endpoint group 11; shared repaired interval length 6.

design.name: medium-groups-to-runs
design.designPurpose: Two groups supply three colour runs, with asymmetric rack endpoints.
design.parameterInvestigation: Exactly two source groups; alternating low/high rack neighbours prevent a rack-only group.

design.name: medium-four-colour-conversion
design.designPurpose: Fourth colour creates another remainder to repair.
design.parameterInvestigation: Group size 4 instead of 3; four rack endpoints.

design.name: medium-runs-to-groups
design.designPurpose: Three missing group partners force both short runs to break.
design.parameterInvestigation: Missing partners use two colours; no three-tile rack run.

design.name: medium-adjacent-rack-partners
design.designPurpose: Adjacent same-colour rack partners differ from separated partners.
design.parameterInvestigation: Rack same-colour pair at adjacent 5/6 rather than endpoints 4/6.

design.name: medium-mixed-group-donation
design.designPurpose: Group donation repairs one side of a broken short run; the other side uses the rack.
design.parameterInvestigation: Optional Medium core; one four-colour group and one three-tile run, five rack tiles.

design.name: hard-interior-extraction
design.designPurpose: A long run loses its middle block while two short runs convert to groups.
design.parameterInvestigation: Long source length 9; duplicate group partners at 4; black 5 forces shared repair.

design.name: hard-split-and-join
design.designPurpose: Shared extraction connects a red run to a divided blue run and a short blue remainder.
design.parameterInvestigation: Duplicate repair tile blue 7; use orange 7, not red 7, to avoid the audited shortcut.

design.name: hard-groups-to-runs
design.designPurpose: Three groups become three runs.
design.parameterInvestigation: Three group sources; unchanged black run supplies required fourth starting row.

design.name: hard-four-colour-group-only
design.designPurpose: Four-colour groups leave four valid colour runs; starting board is group-only.
design.parameterInvestigation: Group size 4; unchanged 10 group supplies required fourth row.

design.name: hard-duplicate-choice
design.designPurpose: An extra matching red run creates alternate allocations without changing the core.
design.parameterInvestigation: Duplicate row is optional useful overlap, not an additional family.

design.name: hard-runs-to-groups
design.designPurpose: The missing fourth colour at 5 forces all three runs to break; duplicate 4s need two groups.
design.parameterInvestigation: Three short runs, four rack tiles, six copies at value 4.

design.name: hard-endpoint-missing-partner
design.designPurpose: The fourth-colour demand is at an endpoint instead of the middle.
design.parameterInvestigation: Missing partner at 6 versus 5, with the duplicate pressure still at 4.

design.name: hard-mixed-exchange
design.designPurpose: Two group conversions repair a short run split at its middle.
design.parameterInvestigation: A tempting rack endpoint can extend the starting blue run but cannot remain with it in a completion.

design.name: hard-longer-mixed-repair
design.designPurpose: Longer right-hand remainder changes the repair interval.
design.parameterInvestigation: Blue source length 4; right repair length 4 rather than 3.

design.name: expert-interior-extraction
design.designPurpose: Duplicate shortages force the long run to split and every short run to convert.
design.parameterInvestigation: One long source plus three short sources; all starting rows are runs.

design.name: expert-longer-interior
design.designPurpose: A longer surviving upper fragment changes the starting geometry.
design.parameterInvestigation: Long source length 10 instead of 9.

design.name: expert-split-and-join
design.designPurpose: The conversion core must also repair the two-tile tail of a fifth source row.
design.parameterInvestigation: Five necessarily changed rows; tail donation at 12; eight rack tiles.

design.name: expert-longer-split-join
design.designPurpose: A six-tile shared repair admits different divisions, all still connected.
design.parameterInvestigation: Tail donation at 13; upper retained source fragment length 4 rather than 3.

design.name: expert-groups-to-runs
design.designPurpose: Retain the useful four-group chain within the broader release mix.
design.parameterInvestigation: Four source groups; independent long-run divisions are audited, not treated as distinct families.

design.name: expert-five-group-conversion
design.designPurpose: Five consecutive groups change, with different possible final run divisions.
design.parameterInvestigation: Five source groups rather than four; same six-tile rack size.

design.name: expert-duplicate-choice
design.designPurpose: Duplicate red run offers alternate origins and preservation choices.
design.parameterInvestigation: Duplicate overlay remains in the groups-to-runs family.

design.name: expert-runs-to-groups
design.designPurpose: Four colour runs become two groups at each value; duplicate partners prevent easier run routes.
design.parameterInvestigation: All four colours present as source runs; a shared duplicate colour spans the three rack values.

design.name: expert-mixed-exchange
design.designPurpose: Three group conversions must repair a split run; tempting rack 2 group has alternate uses.
design.parameterInvestigation: Four changed rows; seven rack tiles; multiple face-level completions.

design.name: expert-combined-repair
design.designPurpose: Interior conversion and four-colour-group donation are both necessary in one component.
design.parameterInvestigation: The donated blue 10 plus rack 11 cannot stand alone; they must use the upper blue fragment.

design.name: expert-longer-combined-repair
design.designPurpose: Longer upper fragment allows more final divisions while both mechanisms remain mandatory.
design.parameterInvestigation: Upper source length 4 instead of 3, donor 11 and rack neighbour 12.

design.name: expert-compact-combined-repair
design.designPurpose: Compact four-row combined repair retains both the necessary group donation and interior rebuilding.
design.parameterInvestigation: Three central source colours rather than four; one long and two short source runs plus a four-colour group; five rack tiles; exact R=4.

design.name: rejected-optional-join
design.designPurpose: Independent repair bypasses the stored connected witness.
design.parameterInvestigation: Extra rack bridge permits disconnected components.

design.name: rejected-hard-duplicate-core
design.designPurpose: Repairing both red and blue endpoints with duplicates creates a conservative endpoint-only shortcut.
design.parameterInvestigation: Red 7 duplicate is rejected; accepted counterpart uses orange 7.

design.name: rejected-expert-two-long-sources
design.designPurpose: Extending a second short source into a long run admits easier structural alternatives.
design.parameterInvestigation: Two long cores versus one; extra length is not automatically safe.

design.name: rejected-expert-duplicate-path
design.designPurpose: A different duplicate pairing admits a disconnected solution.
design.parameterInvestigation: Shared duplicate colour pattern is essential; path is not a safe parameter.

design.name: rejected-expert-boundary-only
design.designPurpose: A four-source redistribution witness disguises a zero-change solution that preserves every original row.
design.parameterInvestigation: Pure same-colour boundary redistribution is not sufficient Expert evidence.

design.name: rejected-easy-interior
design.designPurpose: One-row interior extraction is intentionally outside the narrow Easy predicates.
design.parameterInvestigation: R=1 is necessary but not sufficient for Easy.

design.name: rejected-three-colour-donation
design.designPurpose: A three-colour group cannot donate and retain a valid group.
design.parameterInvestigation: No completion exists for the two stranded 6s.

design.name: rejected-intact-row-extension
design.designPurpose: Extending or joining intact rows requires no rearrangement.
design.parameterInvestigation: Whole-row joins give no difficulty credit.
Three central source colours rather than four; one long and two short source runs plus a four-colour group; five rack tiles; exact R=4.
design.name: rejected-hard-combined-promotion
design.designPurpose: A plausible Hard combined design necessarily changes four rows, so it is rejected as Hard and separately audited as Expert.
